properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. @ajs, 2026-10-21: "Keep A and B as ideas", after asking whether https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40169v1 ("Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution"; read through a summarizer, main text only) could make reflow2 a better DESIGN TOOL for its users, not only improve reflow2 itself. This is idea A of that answer.

THE PAPER keeps the tasks where failures are found and changes are built (D_evo) apart from the tasks that choose between candidates (D_val) and the held-out tasks that report (D_test); what was built from D_evo is frozen while it is judged.

FOR ANY USER'S DESIGN: a Verification records the data (or task set, or sample) it ran on, and whether that data also informed the design it verifies (used to tune, fit, choose or fix it). reflow2 reads a passing check on tuning data as `tuned`, weaker than a check on held-out data, and says so in the verification's reading and in what rests on it, the way 0.90.0 reads a test whose criteria moved after its data as unknown (req:a-test-whose-criteria-moved-after-its-data-reads-unknown-until-acknowledged). Examples: a model fitted and validated on the same measurements; a beamline alignment tuned and accepted on the same scan; a skill fixed and judged by the same trial.

ARENA (by @ajs's line of 2026-10-17): reflow2's cleanly. It records which data and whether it informed the design, and computes the reading. Choosing a held-out set and running the check stay the person's or the agent's.

CHEAP / EXPENSIVE: small to medium. A property or an edge from the Verification to the data it ran on, a reading, and a gap when a design's only passing checks are on tuning data.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS: (i) whether data "informed" a design is the person's assertion, which reflow2 cannot check; an unlabelled check must read as today, never as tuned by default, or every existing design degrades. (ii) Much engineering legitimately accepts on the tuning data (a calibration); the reading must say tuned, never failed.

OPTIONS, none chosen: (a) a property on the Verification (`data_role`: tuning / held_out) and a reading; (b) an edge from the Verification to the data Artifact, and a reading that finds the same data used to change the design; (c) a gap only, no change to readings.
properties.name: OPEN — should a verification say which data it was run on, and whether that same data shaped the design, so a check run on the data the design was tuned to reads as tuned rather than as a clean pass?
properties.rationale: Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40169v1 (read 2026-10-21, main text through a summarizer). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
